authority: coordinator decision 102 (pending owner confirmation): the knowledge-source rows leave the construction roster and cell ROLL-1 flies the clean subset; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-22-stage3-tfrl-base-loop-engineering.md items S3-1/S3-2; rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop BUILD/USE disjointness rule

d1_supplement.note: the R01 D1 media supplement is NOT rebuilt for R01C. It closes over all 800 parent recordings, a strict SUPERSET of R01C's 625, and contracts.gate_media_identity._d1_media_supplement_records verifies the supplement's own integrity and then looks each FLOWN id up in it -- it never requires an exact cover. The R01C runtime view therefore carries the parent's supplement triple verbatim.

draw_method: No draw. R01C is a pure SELECTION of the parent receipt's frozen items: every surviving item is the parent's item verbatim, in the parent's order (ascending sample_id, as core.roster.freeze_roster left it). The seed is the parent's and is carried for provenance only -- no rng is consulted anywhere in this build.

exclusion.granularity: utterance: a recording leaves when ANY recording of its utterance is a knowledge source, the same rule scripts/build_slurp_stage3_r01_excluded_exemplar_store.py applies from the knowledge side
exclusion.rule: R01 minus every recording whose utterance is a source of any composed knowledge store (intent-boundaries-v1, slot-contracts-v2, size-pool-annotated-exemplars-minus-r01); order preserved

knowledge_source_guard.asserted: set(R01C sample ids) & set(composite source_sample_ids) == set(); the exact intersection rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop computes before it dispatches a single row
knowledge_source_guard.derivation: core.config.compose of the ROLL-1 cell's four fragments, then rails.knowledge_stores.load_knowledge_store_binding; the guard set is the composite snapshot's source_sample_ids (the union over composed stores, rails.knowledge_stores._composite). The dataset fragment cannot move this set: only knowledge_stores feeds it.

parent.diversity_report: not recomputed: the parent's farthest-point diversity statistics are a property of the DRAW, and a later selection neither preserves nor invalidates them; read them in the parent receipt

selection_rule: R01 minus every recording whose utterance is a source of any composed knowledge store (intent-boundaries-v1, slot-contracts-v2, size-pool-annotated-exemplars-minus-r01); order preserved
